title: Fellow students of Lorenzo Tio
summary: Nicholas names the four major Tio students: Jimmy Noone, himself, Barney Bigard and Omer Simeon.

blocks.x: And I'm Dick Allen, and Lars Edergren is coming later. He's busy eating breakfast. Let's see, today is June the 20th, what's the date? 26th. 26th, 1972, and we're at 931 Charlotte Street, Lars Edergren's apartment. Oh, one of the things that, you remember Alan Ward, who's a friend of Mike Casimir, he was telling me that you took lessons from Tio? That's right, Lorenzo Tio. Who else would be there at the lessons at the same time? Did you meet any other musicians?
Yeah, yeah. Jimmy Noon was ahead of me. I was second, and Barney Begard and Omar Simeon. Omar Simeon, he was in Chicago. And those were, we were the four major students of Tio.
Old man Tio and his son Lorenzo.
